title: Complex-IF and Beyond: Expert Rubrics for RLVR
authors_zh: Sushant Mehta、Liudas Panavas、Eleanor Fleming、Paul Mains、Edwin Chen
paper_type_zh: 专家 rubric 数据与训练论文
best_for_zh: 用专家准则构建复杂指令评测或 RLVR 奖励的研究者。
one_line: Complex-IF pairs difficult instructions with expert atomic rubrics to support both evaluation and rubric-reward RLVR.
将约千条复杂指令与 10–40 个专家原子 rubric 结合，作为评测和 RLVR 的稠密奖励信号。
why: It exposes rubric-grounded evaluation signals and their audit boundary.
inclusion_reason: The release provides rubric- or judgment-grounded records that can train, evaluate, or audit LLM-based evaluators.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Programmatic verifiers check formats and keywords but poorly judge intent-aware, context-dependent constraints. Generic LLM judges often use broad criteria and are unstable RL rewards. Without expert rubrics, models can learn surface compliance in enterprise-agent and complex-instruction tasks.

This work formulates expert-rubric design principles and uses ComplexConstraints to show that atomic criteria improve evaluation reliability and transferable RLVR signals.

程序 verifier 擅长检查格式和关键词，却难判断意图相关、上下文依赖的复杂约束；通用 LLM Judge 又常使用宽泛标准，无法稳定作为 RL 奖励。缺少专家 rubric 会使模型在企业 Agent 和复杂指令中学习表面合规。

该工作总结专家 rubric 构建原则，并以 ComplexConstraints 验证原子准则既能提高评价可靠性，也能作为可迁移 RLVR 信号。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: ComplexConstraints contains about 75 difficult prompts and 1,559 expert atomic criteria, with 10–40 requirements per prompt. The paper proposes five principles including Maximum Viable Atomicity, intent-aware design, and iterative judge calibration, then uses rubrics in roughly 1,000 training examples and enterprise RL. The data contribution is a dense instruction–criterion object, with evidence of cross-task reinforcement learning.
ComplexConstraints 含约 75 个高难指令和 1,559 条专家原子准则，每题配置 10–40 条要求。论文提出 Maximum Viable Atomicity、意图感知设计和迭代 Judge 校准等五项原则，并将 rubric 用于约 1,000 个训练样本和企业环境 RL。数据贡献是高密度指令—准则对象，方法贡献是跨任务强化学习验证。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Select hard cases: Experts create complex instructions and enterprise-agent scenarios not fully judgeable by string rules.
  1. Atomise rubrics: Intent, exceptions, and context are decomposed into 10–40 maximally viable atomic criteria.
  1. Calibrate judges: Human disagreements and errors iteratively refine criteria and judge prompts.
  1. Use for RL: Criterion compliance becomes rewards for models and agents; weights, judges, and environments must be fixed.

1. 选择难例： 专家编写无法由字符串规则完全判断的复杂指令和企业 Agent 场景。
  1. 原子化 rubric： 依据五项原则将意图、例外和上下文拆为 10–40 条最大可行原子准则。
  1. 校准 Judge： 用人工分歧和错误案例迭代调整准则与 Judge 提示。
  1. 用于 RL： 将准则满足度聚合为奖励，训练不同规模模型和企业 Agent；复现需固定权重、Judge 和环境。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Roughly 1,000 training examples improve a 4B model by 15.5% and a 235B model by 12.2%. After one enterprise RL epoch, transfer gains are 4.5 on BFCL, 7.4 on Tau2-Bench, and 6.8 on Tool-Decathlon. This supports transfer from expert rubrics, although data, judge, and RL recipe change together and gains cannot be attributed only to atomisation.
约 1,000 个训练样本使 4B 模型提升 15.5%、235B 模型提升 12.2%；企业环境单轮 RL 后，BFCL、Tau2-Bench 和 Tool-Decathlon 分别迁移提升 4.5、7.4 和 6.8 点。这支持专家 rubric 的迁移性，但训练数据、Judge 和 RL 配方同时变化，不能将增益只归因于原子化。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Traditional RLVR relies on deterministic verifiers, while rubric RL often generates criteria automatically. This work has experts define atomicity and intent principles and extends the same rubrics from evaluation to enterprise RL. The novelty is feedback-object design and cross-domain transfer, not an optimisation algorithm.
传统 RLVR 依赖确定性 verifier，rubric RL 又常由模型自动生成标准。本文由专家系统定义原子性和意图原则，并用同一 rubric 从评测延伸到企业 Agent RL。新意不在优化算法，而在高质量反馈对象设计和跨域迁移验证。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: About 75 public prompts may miss long-tail complex formulations.
  1. Limitation 2: Expert rubrics are expensive and atomisation levels can differ.
  1. Limitation 3: Policies may learn judge-specific wording and need cross-judge validation.

1. 局限1： 约 75 个公开提示规模小，可能缺少长尾复杂表达。
  1. 局限2： 专家 rubric 成本高，原子化粒度存在分歧。
  1. 局限3： 策略可能学习 Judge 特有措辞，需跨 Judge 验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Build dense rubric data for complex instructions or enterprise agents and train RL rewards.
  1. Use case 2: Use the five principles to audit overlapping, unjudgeable, or style-only criteria.
  1. Use case 3: When reliable program-state checks exist, rubrics should supplement them.

1. 使用场景1： 建立复杂指令或企业 Agent 的高密度 rubric 数据并训练 RL 奖励。
  1. 使用场景2： 用五项原则审计重叠、不可判定或风格化准则。
  1. 使用场景3： 存在可靠程序状态检查时，rubric 应作为补充。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Expert atomic rubrics improve complex-instruction evaluation and RLVR.
  2. Method: Hard cases, five principles, judge calibration, and rubric rewards.
  3. Data: About 75 prompts and 1,559 criteria, extended to roughly 1,000 training examples.
  4. Evidence: 4B/235B improve 15.5%/12.2%, with transfer to three OOD benchmarks.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for non-programmable tasks; guard against judge specialisation.

1. 一句话定位： 专家原子 rubric 可同时提升复杂指令评测和 RLVR。
  2. 方法抓手： 难例、五项原则、Judge 校准和 rubric reward。
  3. 数据抓手： 约 75 提示、1,559 准则，训练扩展约 1,000 样本。
  4. 证据锚点： 4B/235B 提升 15.5%/12.2%，三个 OOD 基准迁移。
  5. 复用决定： 适合非程序任务；须防 Judge 特化。
